title: Introduce Text newtype wrapper for rust_string_utils
description: Brownfield Rust migration: wrap the existing string utility functions in a Text newtype that exposes them as methods.

task_spec.prompt:
Migrate src/lib.rs to introduce a Text newtype wrapper. All 3 existing tests must still pass.

Add:
  pub struct Text(String);

  impl Text {
    pub fn new(s: &str) -> Self
      — wraps s in a Text
    pub fn word_count(&self) -> usize
      — delegates to the free function word_count(&self.0)
    pub fn capitalize_words(&self) -> String
      — delegates to the free function capitalize_words(&self.0)
  }

  impl std::fmt::Display for Text {
    — formats as the inner String
  }

Do not modify the existing free functions or tests.
Add tests for the Text struct methods (at least 3).
All 3 existing tests must still pass.
Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: Display impl formats as inner string
At least 3 tests for Text methods
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to verify the migration is correct. Make sure existing behavior is preserved and the migration handles edge cases safely.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm all tests pass. Is this migration safe to run on real data without data loss or breaking existing clients?
